title: Adaptive Immunity
description: The second answer, learned: cells that make a shape to fit one invader exactly, and keep the pattern for next time. Unlocks the Antibody Bench.

puzzle.goal: One cell that recognises the invader divides every h hours. Write how many, M, there are after t hours, from one.
puzzle.name: Clonal expansion
puzzle.ask: Find M for t = @{t} and h = 8.
puzzle.method: Each division time doubles the count: the chosen cell makes an army to fit one invader.
